//: The parent tsconfig includes only `src`, so the UI was never typechecked: Vite transpiles with esbuild, which strips types without checking them. This config exists so `make autoedit-ui-typecheck` can gate the UI on its own. It is separate rather than added to the parent's include because `src/Root.tsx` and `src/Explainer.tsx` carry pre-existing type errors that would mask any new UI error.
